sections.heading: tySplinerObject
sections.content: ThetySplinerobject can be used to non-destructively combine spline objects together.

sections.heading: Input splines
sections.content:
Object list: the list of spline objects that will be combined together.Hide after adding: controls whether objects will be hidden in the scene after adding them to the listbox.

Object list: the list of spline objects that will be combined together.

Hide after adding: controls whether objects will be hidden in the scene after adding them to the listbox.

sections.heading: Display
sections.content:
Show icon: controls whether thetySplinericon is displayed in the viewport.Icon size: controls the size of thetySplinericon.Show name: displays the name of thetySplinernext to its icon in the viewport.

Show icon: controls whether thetySplinericon is displayed in the viewport.

Icon size: controls the size of thetySplinericon.

sections.heading: Coordinates Rollout
sections.content: Local/World: controls the coordinate system that the resulting splines will be displayed in.
